name: Atlai
title: One of the sons of Bebai who sent away his foreign wife
summary: Atlai was one of the descendants of Bebai who lived in the period after the Babylonian exile. He was among the Israelite men who had taken foreign wives and, following Ezra's exhortation, agreed to send them away to preserve the religious purity of the people.

keyEvents.title: Listed among those who had taken foreign wives
keyEvents.description: Atlai is mentioned among the sons of Bebai who had married foreign women, which was contrary to the Mosaic Law.

keyEvents.title: Ezra's reform against mixed marriages
keyEvents.description: Ezra discovered that many Israelites, including priests and Levites, had married women from the surrounding nations, and he called a large assembly to address the matter.

keyEvents.title: The people's pledge to send away their foreign wives
keyEvents.description: After Ezra's prayer and exhortation, the people, including Atlai, agreed to send away their foreign wives and follow God's law.

keyEvents.title: Appointment of leaders to investigate the cases
keyEvents.description: Family heads were appointed to examine all cases of mixed marriages, and the matter was thoroughly addressed over a period of time.
